$comment: This app, as Fact Explorer sees it.
The descriptor lives here rather than inside Fact Explorer so the values sit beside the
Main.scala they mirror, and so this repo stays self-contained. Fact Explorer's
scripts/build-registry.mjs globs ../*/fact-explorer.app.json and merges every one it finds — so
this file IS the registration. Put this repo beside fact-explorer and it appears in the app
picker; there is no list to edit.
Keep in step with src/main/scala/.../Main.scala and this repo's Makefile PORT.
label: Benefits Enrollment
$comment_capabilities: What this app was generated with. Fact Explorer prunes its menu from these: an app without
allScreens gets no Browse All or Path Mode entry, because those pages do not exist and the link
$comment_scenarios: null when this app has no scenario corpus — Fact Explorer then shows a scenario picker with no
filter dropdowns rather than a broken one. `vocabulary` names a filter set in
fact-explorer/src/model/scenarios/; 'none' is the floor and is always available.
$comment_customFlowTags: Mirror FormBuilderApp.nodeTypes here. A flow tag the scaffold has never heard of reaches the graph
as a real node only if it is declared — undeclared tags are rejected, which is what makes a typo
$comment_pagePrefixes: Short ids for the node generator, one per route. Optional — without it a node id is minted from
the whole route — but this flow's routes are long enough that the graph reads better with them.
